title: Longest Substring With At Most K Distinct Characters
description: Find the length of the longest substring containing at most k distinct characters.

steps.note: Initialize sliding window with string 'eceba' and k=2
Add 'b' to map. Map: {e: 2, c: 1, b: 1}. Size > 2.
Shrink window. Decrement 'e' at index 0. Map: {e: 1, c: 1, b: 1}
Shrink window. Decrement 'c' at index 1. Map: {e: 1, b: 1}
